protocol: 512 previously screened frames, same independent 64-frame RGB template and best-frame anchor 1638. Each raw CFA backprojection computed once and shared by both accumulators, guaranteeing identical motion and samples. The weighted arm uses original full-capture cached screening scores, not unsmoothed green scores. Constant-colour weighted and equal results match independently calculated means within 1e-12. Identical output validity. No sharpening or further rejection.
decision: Retain cached quality weighting: it improves both metrics relative to equal weighting. Next test one squared-quality candidate, retaining every screened frame and first checking known-blur/noise controls; no exponent sweep or default rejection change.
